author: Xu Han
note: Learning/portfolio demonstrator. NOT a calibrated observatory simulator, NOT an exposure-time calculator, NOT a reproduction of HARMONI/MUSE/NIRSpec, and NOT a validated performance prediction.

truth_levels.intrinsic: synthetic galaxy cube after the photon budget, before public conditioning
truth_levels.conditioned: after CALSPEC continuum shape x SkyCalc telluric x SVO Ks filter (pre-PSF)
truth_levels.observed: reduction-matched: noiseless sky-free source through the same PSF+LSF+cross-talk+weighted reconstruction (same variance weights as the science cube), post-PSF and not deconvolved; reduction-specific, not an intrinsic or strictly deterministic truth
truth_levels.reduced_recovery: noisy sky-added observation after forward-modelled sky subtraction

recovery_estimators.window_sum: fixed-window continuum-subtracted integral over +/-3 resolution elements
recovery_estimators.gaussian_fit: Gaussian+continuum least-squares fit of the aperture spectrum (flux, velocity, width, fitted R, formal errors)

aperture_uncertainty.covariance_aware: AR(1) covariance-inflated SNR from the lag-1 spectral autocorrelation; approximate, NOT a full covariance matrix
aperture_uncertainty.note: reconstructed noise is added per-pixel after the LSF and each channel reads a distinct detector column, so the isolated-noise autocorrelation is ~0 and the diagonal SNR is ~valid here; the diagnostic would catch correlation if present.

provenance.name: telescope_diameter
provenance.notes: 39.0 m aperture; not a facility prediction.

provenance.name: ifu_spaxel_scale
provenance.url_or_reference: HARMONI image slicer arXiv:1807.06313; MUSE arXiv:astro-ph/0606329
provenance.notes: 10.0 mas spaxel; inspired values, not a reproduction.

provenance.name: sky_spectrum
provenance.notes: Cached SkyCalc-style sky model (radiance + telluric transmission).

provenance.name: source_spectrum
provenance.notes: Cached source spectrum, e.g. CALSPEC/PHOENIX, peak-normalised.

provenance.name: filter_K
provenance.notes: Cached filter curve; original e.g. SVO Filter Profile Service.

provenance.name: filter_throughput
provenance.url_or_reference: SVO 2MASS Ks transmission as a wavelength-dependent bandpass
provenance.notes: Filter curve multiplies the source spectrum (bandpass weighting), not a flat scalar.

provenance.name: sky_background
provenance.notes: Physically-motivated unit conversion; ABSOLUTE level is an engineering estimate (sky_scaling=1.0), NOT a calibrated ETC.

provenance.name: ao_psf
provenance.notes: Strehl-weighted core+halo, Strehl=0.5; no real AO residual model.

provenance.name: ifu_remapping
provenance.url_or_reference: image-slicer proxy (concept: HARMONI arXiv:1807.06313, NIRSpec arXiv:physics/0512002)
provenance.notes: Rectangular slicer with deterministic trace table; not real slicer geometry.

provenance.name: detector_noise
provenance.url_or_reference: H2RG/H4RG-like: MOSFIRE arXiv:1208.0314, NIRSpec arXiv:2208.12686, Rauscher arXiv:1509.06264
provenance.notes: read_noise=8.0 e-, dark=0.005 e-/s; engineering proxies, not real detector cosmetics.

provenance.name: cube_reconstruction
provenance.url_or_reference: controlled inverse mapping (concept: MUSE pipeline arXiv:2006.08638, Horne 1986)
provenance.notes: Nearest + inverse-variance (Horne-like) extraction, each with its own propagated variance (weighted: Var=1/sum(P^2/V)); not a real pipeline.

provenance.name: sky_subtraction
provenance.notes: Perfect-calibration assumption scaled by (1 + 0.0); the sky's photon noise stays in the data and the variance. NOT a real sky reduction or calibrated ETC.

limitations: Synthetic high-z galaxy, not a real observation.
Sky background level is an engineering_estimate, not a calibrated ETC; sky subtraction assumes a perfectly known forward-modelled sky (scale error configurable).
Recovery bias is quoted against the observed truth (post-PSF+LSF+reconstruction); no deconvolved intrinsic recovery is claimed.

Weighted reconstruction can over-count flux from closely packed traces; the over-count cancels in the matched-surface comparison but is visible against pre-PSF truth (see line_flux_observed_over_conditioned).
The covariance-aware SNR uses a single lag-1 AR(1) proxy, not a full spectral covariance matrix; it is an approximate inflation, not a calibrated error budget.
